ShareID

Authentication with official identity

Image
Sara Sebti

Co-founder & CEO

Image
Sawsen Rezig

Co-founder & CTO

ShareID is an AI-powered cybersecurity solution that disrupts strong customer authentification. ShareID brings simplicity and the efficiency of physical identity checks to the digital world.

Headquartered in Paris, with offices in San Francisco, ShareID provides authentication as a service linked to the official ID document and captured with a simple smile. Thanks to its patented technology, personal data and biometrics are never stored, making ShareID compliant with international data privacy and protection laws.

ShareID serves the purpose of bring by a digital world in which people feel safe to share their data and to know who they are sharing their data with.

https://www.shareid.ai/

DECIDE WITH DATA

Home
Portfolio
Rwazi
ACTIVE NORTH AMERICA AFRICA B2B SAAS 2022 SEED
Rwazi

Decide with data

Image
Joseph Rutakangwa

Co-founder - CEO

Image
Eric Sewankambo

Co-founder - COO

The emerging economies are the fastest growing markets, yet getting accurate data is challenging. 98% of the transactions in Africa are in traditional outlets, 93% of those retailers do not have a POS and 90% of the transactions are still in cash.


Rwazi’s customers come with a list of questions that the startup transforms into quantitative and sometimes qualitative questions sent to gig workers called “mappers” who have the Rwazi app and are located in the regions the customer is interested in. The main use cases are:

- Capture real customer experiences to improve retail execution and drive loyalty Understand the competitive landscape

- Fill distribution gaps and drive sales

- Correct pricing, planogram, and promotional compliance issues

- Ensure product freshness and eliminate counterfeits
 

To date, the company has built a network of 30K mappers, mainly in Africa. The data crowdsourced by the mappers is then verified via geo and time stamps, and shared with the customer via a web app

https://www.rwazi.com/

Newfund investor: Henri Deshays

Infinite Orbits

The future of space exploration 

Image
Adel Haddoud

Co-Founder & CEO

Image
Akshay Gulati

Co-Founder & CTO

Image
Manos Koumandakis

Co-Founder & Chief Architect 

The evolving space economy, fueled by SpaceX and other's rapid launches and innovative technologies, poses competitive challenges, prompting Infinite Orbits, led by Adel Haddoud, Akshay Gulati and Manos Koumandakis, to pioneer cost-effective in-orbit services.

Specializing in space rendezvous maneuvers using advanced camera-based systems and AI-powered image processing, Infinite Orbits offers cost-effective solutions for various in-orbit tasks, including observation missions and extending the lifespan of satellites. 

In May of 2023, Infinite Orbits launched its debut nanosatellite via SpaceX's Falcon Heavy, marking its maiden commercial mission in geostationary orbit. With five clients onboard, including Intelsat, the company eyes swift expansion of its U.S. commercial operations.

Infinite Orbits was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Toulouse, France.

SCREEN-FREE PHONES FOR CHILDREN

Home
Portfolio
Tin Can
ACTIVE NORTH AMERICA HARDWARE 2025
Tin Can

Screen-free phones for children

Image
Chet Kittleson

CEO

Image
Graeme Davies

COO

Image
Max Blumen

CTO

Tin Can develops WiFi-enabled landline-style phones designed for children. The devices allow kids to communicate without access to screens, apps, or the internet. Parents manage contacts through a companion mobile application, ensuring that only approved numbers can be reached. Additional features include quiet hours, voicemail, and optional 911 calling.

The company launched its product in 2023 and quickly sold out its initial production runs. Tin Can offers two service plans: a free plan allowing calls between Tin Can devices, and a paid plan enabling calls to external approved numbers.

Tin Can addresses a growing concern among families regarding children’s early exposure to smartphones and social media. By providing a simple and controlled communication device, the company offers an alternative that combines safety, independence, and ease of use.

Tin Can is based in Seattle, WA.
